name: Badge
description: A compact status or metadata pill for dense product UI.

children.description: Short label text. May include a leading decorative icon as composition; Badge has no icon prop.

variant.description: Visual tone for short product states. Muted is low-emphasis fill; outline is the only bordered badge variant.

size.description: Density. Use xs for table/status pills instead of arbitrary text/height overrides.

render.description: Polymorphic render target, Base UI style. Use for links only when the badge is genuinely navigational.

className.description: Escape hatch for layout only; do not restyle variant, size, color, or radius.

forbidden: Do not use Badge as a button; use Button or a menu item for actions.
Do not create one-off text-[10px] / h-[18px] badges; use size="xs".
Do not invent custom status colors via className; use the closed tone variants or add a real variant.
Do not add custom visible borders. `outline` is the only bordered variant.
Do not imply Badge has an icon prop; icons are composed through children.

responsive.note: A static badge is not a touch target. If rendered as a link, place it in a row or hit area that reaches 44px.

example:
<Badge variant="muted" size="xs">Queued</Badge>
<Badge variant="positive">Active</Badge>
<Badge variant="warning"><Clock3 aria-hidden />Due soon</Badge>
